quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The device you plug in to give your phone battery power.
quests.explanation: A charger refills a device's battery through a cable. Forgetting one is a very common modern travel problem.
quests.textToSpeak: I forgot to pack my phone charger for the trip.
quests.textWithBlanks: I forgot to pack my phone ___ for the trip.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Having a bad physical reaction to certain foods or substances.
quests.explanation: Allergic describes a strong negative reaction to something like food or pollen. 'Checks the label' shows a smart safety habit.
quests.textToSpeak: He is allergic to peanuts, so he always checks the label.
quests.textWithBlanks: He is ___ to peanuts, so he always checks the label.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A performer whose job is to make people laugh.
quests.explanation: A comedian performs jokes and funny stories on stage or on television. 'Made the whole audience laugh' shows a very successful show.
quests.textToSpeak: The comedian made the whole audience laugh for an hour.
quests.textWithBlanks: The ___ made the whole audience laugh for an hour.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A machine connected to a computer that puts text or images on paper.
quests.explanation: A printer turns digital documents into paper copies. 'Ran out of paper' is one of the most common office annoyances.
quests.textToSpeak: The office printer ran out of paper again.
quests.textWithBlanks: The office ___ ran out of paper again.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A pain that you feel inside your head.
quests.explanation: A headache is common pain in the head, often eased with medicine or rest. 'Took a tablet' is the natural response to this problem.
quests.textToSpeak: She took a tablet because she had a bad headache.
quests.textWithBlanks: She took a tablet because she had a bad ___.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The group of people watching a performance.
quests.explanation: An audience is the crowd watching a concert, film, or play. Thanking the audience is a common, polite way to end a performance.
quests.textToSpeak: The singer thanked the audience at the end of the show.
quests.textWithBlanks: The singer thanked the ___ at the end of the show.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A secret word or code used to access an account safely.
quests.explanation: A password protects your account from other people. 'Couldn't log in' describes a common frustration when we forget one.
quests.textToSpeak: He couldn't log in because he forgot his password.
quests.textWithBlanks: He couldn't log in because he forgot his ___.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A substance used to treat an illness or ease pain.
quests.explanation: Medicine treats illness and is often taken on a schedule. 'Twice a day with food' is a typical instruction found on a medicine label.
quests.textToSpeak: Take this medicine twice a day with food.
quests.textWithBlanks: Take this ___ twice a day with food.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The music that plays throughout a film or show.
quests.explanation: A soundtrack is the collection of music used in a film. Sometimes it becomes even more famous than the film it was written for.
quests.textToSpeak: The soundtrack of the film became more popular than the movie itself.
quests.textWithBlanks: The ___ of the film became more popular than the movie itself.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A new version of a program or app with improvements or fixes.
quests.explanation: An update improves an app or program, often fixing problems. 'Install... tonight' suggests it's a routine, low-effort task.
quests.textToSpeak: Please install the latest software update tonight.
quests.textWithBlanks: Please install the latest software ___ tonight.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Physical activity done to stay fit and healthy.
quests.explanation: Exercise keeps your body fit and can even improve your sleep. 'Regular' means done often and consistently, not just once.
quests.textToSpeak: Regular exercise helps you sleep better at night.
quests.textWithBlanks: Regular ___ helps you sleep better at night.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: One part of a television series.
quests.explanation: An episode is a single instalment of a TV series. Watching several in one sitting is often called 'binge-watching.'
quests.textToSpeak: We watched three episode of the show in one evening.
quests.textWithBlanks: We watched three ___ of the show in one evening.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A wireless connection that lets devices access the internet.
quests.explanation: Wifi lets phones and laptops connect to the internet without cables. 'Too slow to load' is a very relatable modern complaint.
quests.textToSpeak: The wifi in the café was too slow to load the page.
quests.textWithBlanks: The ___ in the café was too slow to load the page.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A body temperature that is higher than normal because of illness.
quests.explanation: A fever is a sign the body is fighting an infection. 'Stayed home from school' is the sensible response to this symptom.
quests.textToSpeak: The child had a fever and stayed home from school.
quests.textWithBlanks: The child had a ___ and stayed home from school.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Written text at the bottom of a screen that translates or shows spoken words.
quests.explanation: Subtitles help viewers follow a film in another language. They're also a useful listening-and-reading tool for language learners.
quests.textToSpeak: She turned on the subtitles to understand the foreign film.
quests.textWithBlanks: She turned on the ___ to understand the foreign film.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: To copy a file or program from the internet onto your device.
quests.explanation: Download means to save something from the internet onto your phone or computer — the opposite of 'upload.'
quests.textToSpeak: It only takes a minute to download the app.
quests.textWithBlanks: It only takes a minute to ___ the app.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A strip of cloth used to cover and protect a wound.
quests.explanation: A bandage protects an injury while it heals. 'Wrapped around' describes exactly how it's applied.
quests.textToSpeak: He wrapped a bandage around his injured ankle.
quests.textWithBlanks: He wrapped a ___ around his injured ankle.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A practice session before a real performance.
quests.explanation: A rehearsal lets performers practise before the real show. 'Opening night' is the exciting first public performance.
quests.textToSpeak: The actors had one final rehearsal before opening night.
quests.textWithBlanks: The actors had one final ___ before opening night.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The connection strength that lets a phone send and receive information.
quests.explanation: Signal describes how strong a phone's connection is. Tunnels often block it completely, which explains the missed call.
quests.textToSpeak: I couldn't call you because there was no signal in the tunnel.
quests.textWithBlanks: I couldn't call you because there was no ___ in the tunnel.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A natural substance found in food that keeps your body healthy.
quests.explanation: Vitamins are nutrients your body needs in small amounts to stay healthy. Vitamin C is especially linked with citrus fruits like oranges.
quests.textToSpeak: Oranges contain a lot of vitamin C.
quests.textWithBlanks: Oranges contain a lot of ___ C.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Special clothing worn to look like a different character.
quests.explanation: A costume helps an actor look like the character they are playing. School plays are a classic place to see creative costumes.
quests.textToSpeak: She wore a colourful costume for the school play.
quests.textWithBlanks: She wore a colourful ___ for the school play.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The set of buttons used to type on a computer.
quests.explanation: A keyboard is used to type letters and numbers into a computer. 'A few keys' shows only part of it was broken, not the whole thing.
quests.textToSpeak: A few keys on his keyboard stopped working.
quests.textWithBlanks: A few keys on his ___ stopped working.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The usual food and drink a person consumes.
quests.explanation: A diet describes what someone regularly eats, not just a weight-loss plan. 'Healthy diet' is a very common collocation in English.
quests.textToSpeak: Eating more vegetables is part of a healthy diet.
quests.textWithBlanks: Eating more vegetables is part of a healthy ___.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The sound of many people clapping their hands together.
quests.explanation: Applause shows appreciation after a performance. 'Loud applause' suggests the audience really enjoyed the show.
quests.textToSpeak: The performance ended with loud applause from the crowd.
quests.textWithBlanks: The performance ended with loud ___ from the crowd.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A saved image of exactly what is showing on a screen.
quests.explanation: A screenshot captures whatever is on your screen at that moment. It's a quick way to share a problem or a funny message with someone.
quests.textToSpeak: He took a screenshot of the error message to show his colleague.
quests.textWithBlanks: He took a ___ of the error message to show his colleague.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A sign that shows a person may be ill.
quests.explanation: A symptom is a clue your body gives that something is wrong. Recognising early symptoms can help you rest before you feel worse.
quests.textToSpeak: A sore throat is often the first symptom of a cold.
quests.textWithBlanks: A sore throat is often the first ___ of a cold.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The person in charge of making a film or show.
quests.explanation: A director controls the creative decisions behind a film. 'Reshoot the final scene' means filming it again to get it right.
quests.textToSpeak: The director decided to reshoot the final scene.
quests.textWithBlanks: The ___ decided to reshoot the final scene.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A short message or alert that appears on a screen.
quests.explanation: A notification alerts you to a new message or update. Constant notifications during meetings are a common modern distraction.
quests.textToSpeak: Her phone buzzed with another notification during the meeting.
quests.textWithBlanks: Her phone buzzed with another ___ during the meeting.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A doctor's written instruction that lets you buy certain medicine.
quests.explanation: A prescription is required for medicine that isn't available over the counter. 'Stronger painkillers' shows the first treatment wasn't enough.
quests.textToSpeak: The doctor wrote a prescription for stronger painkillers.
quests.textWithBlanks: The doctor wrote a ___ for stronger painkillers.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A film, book, or show that continues the story of an earlier one.
quests.explanation: A sequel continues a story that audiences already love. 'Waiting years' shows just how excited and patient the fans have been.
quests.textToSpeak: Fans have been waiting years for the sequel to come out.
quests.textWithBlanks: Fans have been waiting years for the ___ to come out.
